messages:
maria: heads up — after last night's RBAC refactor I found 3 service accounts that can call kms:Decrypt on customer CMKs (svc-ingest-a/b/c). Appears to be an unintended role permission carry-over. :eyes:

maria: found via automated alert and quick grep in audit logs. sample log: `2026-03-20T01:12:34Z - svc-ingest-a - kms:Decrypt - key=cust-123 - result=ALLOWED`

maria: escalating — need immediate mitigation before we hit any customer exposure. @alex can you apply a temp deny? :lock:

alex: on it. I'll push a scoped deny rule for those principals and remove kms:Decrypt from the refactored role. Pushing now.

alex: applying temp lockdown via admin API:```
PATCH https://admin.internal/api/v1/rbac/override
{
  "principals": ["svc-ingest-a","svc-ingest-b","svc-ingest-c"],
  "deny": ["kms:Decrypt"]
}
```

chris: I'll add a high-priority audit filter to track any decrypts to customer CMKs in the last 7 days and tail for new events. Query I'm running:```
resource.type="kms_key"
protoPayload.methodName=("cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.decrypt" "cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricDecrypt")
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=~"svc-ingest-"
```

sam: fyi we can rotate the affected CMKs but that will break currently running ingest jobs. prefer patch roles first then rotate if we see signs of misuse.

security-oncall: recommend we file an incident (P1) and notify compliance/legal. If we had any decrypts to customer keys outside expected principals we need to prepare customer notifications per policy.

ir-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-745, channel #incident-inc-2026-745, severity=P1. Pager duty notified.

alex: temp deny applied at 2026-03-20T01:14:56Z. Confirmed policy push returned 200. Rolling back the refactor PR in prod config to prevent re-deploy.

maria: verified — audit tail shows zero decrypt events from those principals after the deny. Will monitor for 30m then decide on key rotation.

chris: saved audit query and exported matching events since 2026-03-13 for triage. No obvious exfil pattern so far but still looking.

sam: prepping a runbook entry for controlled key rotation if needed. Note: ops will need to coordinate a short maintenance window.

security-oncall: assigning owners for postmortem: maria (sec lead), alex (eng infra), chris (audit). Please collect timeline, PR diff for the RBAC change, and all audit events.

maria: creating postmortem draft in #inc-docs and linking to the incident. Initial mitigation status: locked down, audit filter active, incident open.

alex: unit tests for role boundaries being added to CI to prevent regressions. I'll open PR that pins explicit deny for kms:Decrypt on non-kms-owners.

maria: thanks team. keep updates in the incident channel. tagging legal: @security-oncall please loop them when we have the exported events. :white_check_mark:
